caption:
Shopping bags feeling heavier lately? Menopause can be a great time to build strength.

Hormone changes around menopause are linked to faster loss of muscle and bone. Research suggests regular, progressive resistance exercise is one of the most helpful ways to support both.

Reformer springs let you add resistance gradually, easing back on tougher days. Achy joints can often still move in a comfortable range, and pelvic floor awareness can be part of your sessions too. Feeling strong and steady can make everyday tasks and travel feel more doable.

A swollen joint, worsening pain, dizziness or breathlessness is worth getting checked. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
